newsitem.title: CANADA: DBRS confirms Cambridge Shopping debt.
newsitem.headline: DBRS confirms Cambridge Shopping debt.

text.p: Dominion Bond Rating Service on Thursday confirmed Cambridge Shopping Centres Ltd convertible subordinated debentures at BBB with a stable trend.
The agency cited Cambridge's success in boosting sales per square foot in its shopping centre portfolio, despite a tough retail environment.

"It has been acquisition-oriented, purchasing a joint venture partner's interest in five major shopping centres, and active in forging new alliances, as with the Mills Corp of Virginia...for the development of mega malls in Canada," DBRS said.
